parameter.name: domain
parameter.description:
The primary Azure Entra ID domain name used for authentication. This value .B SHOULD match the domain name that users enter when signing in (for example, the domain portion of their UPN).
In most cases, this will be the primary domain of your Azure Entra ID tenant. If your organization uses multiple verified domains or aliases, choose the one that your users actually use to sign in.
This legacy format selects one provider. If several domains are listed (comma-separated or through additional domain sections), the first is used and a warning is logged. Use one [tenant.<label>] section per provider for multi-tenant setups. If .B oidc_issuer_url is set, this option is ignored.
Configure a provider before starting the daemon.
parameter.conf_description: Primary Entra ID domain used for user sign-in.
